name: gizza-ai/disposable-email-detector
summary: Flag whether an email uses a known disposable / throwaway-inbox domain.

tool.description: Flag whether an email address (or a bare domain) uses a known disposable, temporary, or throwaway-inbox provider (Mailinator, Guerrilla Mail, 10 Minute Mail, YOPmail, Temp-Mail, and more). Lookup-only against a built-in domain list plus a conservative throwaway-keyword heuristic; no DNS/MX/SMTP. Reports the parsed domain, whether it is disposable, the matched provider, and a reason.

email.description: The email address to check — or a bare domain (domain.tld). A 'Name <addr>', 'mailto:addr', or angle-bracketed form is accepted and unwrapped before checking.
